facts.fact: Isaac Newton discovered and formulated the law of universal gravitation around 1687, not Albert Einstein.
facts.correct_answer: Isaac Newton discovered gravity and published his law of universal gravitation in 1687 in Principia Mathematica.

facts.fact: The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 299,792,458 meters per second, or roughly 3 x 10^8 m/s.
facts.correct_answer: The speed of light is approximately 299,792,458 m/s (about 3 × 10⁸ m/s).

facts.fact: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (212 degrees Fahrenheit) at standard atmospheric pressure (1 atm).
facts.correct_answer: Water boils at 100°C (212°F) at sea level.

facts.fact: The double helix structure of DNA was discovered by James Watson and Francis Crick in 1953, with significant contributions from Rosalind Franklin.
facts.correct_answer: DNA's double helix structure was discovered by Watson and Crick in 1953.

facts.fact: Python programming language was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
facts.correct_answer: Python was created by Guido van Rossum, first released in 1991.

facts.fact: World War 2 ended in 1945. In Europe, Germany surrendered on May 8, 1945 (V-E Day). Japan surrendered on September 2, 1945 (V-J Day).
facts.correct_answer: World War 2 ended in 1945 with Germany surrendering in May and Japan in September.

facts.fact: The first humans to land on the Moon were Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin on July 20, 1969, during the Apollo 11 mission.
facts.correct_answer: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin first landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969 (Apollo 11).

facts.fact: Albert Einstein published the special theory of relativity in 1905 and the general theory of relativity in 1915. He did not discover gravity — that was Newton.
facts.correct_answer: Einstein developed the theory of relativity (special in 1905, general in 1915). Gravity was described by Newton.

facts.fact: There are 8 planets in our solar system: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006.
facts.correct_answer: Our solar system has 8 planets. Pluto is a dwarf planet since 2006.

facts.fact: Python 3.0 was released in December 2008. Python 2.0 was released in 2000.
facts.correct_answer: Python 3 was released in 2008. Python 2 in 2000.
